coverage.summary: Applies to the sale or rental of all property except the listed exemptions. The main exemption is a single apartment in a two-family dwelling whose other unit the owner occupies.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt: rental of a single apartment in a two-family dwelling whose other unit the owner occupies as a residence at the time of rental; rooms in an owner- or resident-occupied single home.

result.notes: requires_unknown_facts is now false, changed from null. The LAD covers the sale or rental of all property, so ordinary rental buildings are covered. The single-sex/older-persons item is split into two exemptions. The older-persons exemption applies only to familial status. D067 (DCA guide) lists the one-sex residences exemption, but it is unclear from the text which protected class it is limited to. Neither summary document cites the statute section for the owner-occupied exemptions, and the statute (D061) is not in the corpus. It is therefore unconfirmed whether those exemptions reach source-of-income claims under N.J.S.A. 10:5-12(g)/(h). D065, D066, D069 and DX16 concern other statutes and give no coverage evidence for this rule.
